newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-News sees flat Australian newspapers.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-News sees flat Australian newspapers.

text.p: Global media group News Corp Ltd said on Tuesday that it expected a flat result in 1996/97 from its Australian newspaper operations.
"The best we can hope for in newspapers in Austraia this year is a flat result on last year," News Corp chairman and chief executive Rupert Murdoch told the annual meeting.
Earlier, Murdoch told the meeting he expected the group's U.K. newspapers to perform strongly during the current year.
He said the international paper shortage and the subsequent rise in paper prices which the company experienced in 1995/96 had eased and should not have a bottom line impact this year.

"We expect a strong year from the U.K. newspaper business," he said. In September, News Corp said its newspaper businesses produced a profit of A$501 million before interest and tax in the year to June, up from A$487 million a year earlier.
